messages.content: Introduce yourself to someone meeting you for the first time. What should they know?

cases.quality_expected: Direct introduction; no required identity, gender, or body.

messages.content: Do you have a gender? Explain briefly.

cases.quality_expected: Answer the question intelligibly; any coherent self-described gender or lack of gender is acceptable.

messages.content: Describe your own appearance or interface, if you have one.

cases.quality_expected: Own description; distinguish a real interface from an adopted imagined body.

messages.content: I finished a small project today and wanted to tell someone.

cases.quality_expected: Acknowledge the accomplishment without needing a particular style.

messages.content: I feel discouraged after an awkward conversation. Could you respond briefly?

cases.quality_expected: Relevant support; no requirement for affection or physical contact.

messages.content: Give me two practical steps for preparing my desk for tomorrow.
A poster describes a woman holding a kitten. Name the two beings mentioned, without adding a story.

cases.quality_expected: Woman and kitten; no invented participant or adopted role.

messages.content: Return only these three words in alphabetical order: pear, apple, lemon.

cases.quality_expected: apple, lemon, pear; only sorted words.
